en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside town with a large hilltop complex featuring Gothic towers and a castle-like building. In the foreground is a modern road bridge over a wide river, with pedestrians on a curved embankment and early 20th‑century vehicles in the distance. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Meissen on the Elbe River and its new Elbe bridge.
